Item 8.01
Other Events.
On November 5, 2026, TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (the “Company” or “TKO”) announced the commencement of an offering (the “Offering”) of $1.0 billion in aggregate principal amount of Senior Secured Notes due 2031 (the “notes”) by TKO Worldwide Holdings, LLC (“TKO Worldwide”) (f/k/a UFC Holdings, LLC), an indirect subsidiary of TKO. A copy of the press release is attached hereto as Exhibit 99.1 and is hereby incorporated by reference.
On November 5, 2026, TKO announced the pricing of the Offering described above. A copy of the press release is attached hereto as Exhibit 99.2 and is hereby incorporated by reference.
This Current Report on Form 8-K does not constitute an offer to sell or the solicitation of an offer to buy the notes or any other security and shall not constitute an offer, solicitation or sale of the notes or any other security in any jurisdiction in which such offering, solicitation or sale would be unlawful. entertainment company, today announced the launch of an oﬀering (the “Offering”) of $1.0 billion in aggregate principal amount of Senior Secured Notes due 2031 (the “notes”) by its indirect subsidiary, TKO
Worldwide Holdings, LLC (“TKO Worldwide”). Completion of the Offering is subject to, among other things, pricing and customary closing conditions.
